source_documents.title: Tuning the singlet-triplet energy gap: a unique approach to efficient photosensitizers with aggregation-induced emission (AIE) characteristics

reference_evidence_units.quote: the DEST values of TPDC, TPPDC and PPDC are 0.48, 0.35 and 0.27 eV, respectively
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPDC, TPPDC and PPDC
reference_evidence_units.statement: TPPDC has a calculated singlet-triplet gap of 0.35 eV.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Calculated gaps are not directly measured ISC rates. The interpretation assumes similar spin-orbit couplings across analogues.

reference_evidence_units.quote: close molecular structures suggest a similar amount of spin–orbit coupling between S1 and T1
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPDC, TPPDC and PPDC
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors use approximately comparable spin-orbit coupling to relate gap reduction to increased ISC.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Keep this as an assumption; chemical similarity does not prove equal spin-orbit coupling.

reference_evidence_units.quote: all three compounds are almost non- emissive in pure DMSO and they gradually become emissive
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPDC, TPPDC and PPDC
reference_evidence_units.conditions: DMSO/water series, Figure 2; 10 micromolar as visually checked in the figure caption.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The three compounds show aggregation-associated emission enhancement.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: PDF text extraction corrupts micro to m in some places. No isolated viscosity or motion intervention is reported in this selected evidence.

reference_evidence_units.quote: PPDC, TPPDC and TPDC were calculated to be 0.89, 0.32 and 0.28, respectively
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPDC, TPPDC and PPDC
reference_evidence_units.conditions: ABDA photodegradation relative to Rose Bengal, absorption-normalized quantum yield.
reference_evidence_units.statement: TPPDC has a reported singlet-oxygen yield of 0.32.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This is a probe-based derived yield, not a direct triplet-population measurement.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the white light irradi- ation on ABDA alone does not lead to an obvious change in absorbance
reference_evidence_units.subject: ABDA-only negative control
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Same white-light conditions as photosensitizer experiments.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The probe-only control does not show the photosensitizer-associated absorbance loss.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This supports photosensitization but does not by itself rule out all probe interferences.

reference_evidence_units.quote: small DEST values can be realized via intramolecular charge transfer within molecular systems containing spatially separated donor and acceptor moieties
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPDC, TPPDC and PPDC design
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Design rationale with target-specific HOMO/LUMO plots in Figure 1.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source uses donor-acceptor charge separation to explain the reduced gap across the series.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This supports a CT design account, not independently verified TICT kinetics.

reference_evidence_units.quote: they were chosen for 1O2 generation comparison in cells
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPDC and PPDC
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Cell studies on TAT-functionalized nanoparticle formulations.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Only TPDC and PPDC were selected for the cell comparison.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Do not attribute those cellular results to TPPDC or to free isolated dyes.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Charge-separated donor-acceptor design is the proposed route to the smaller singlet-triplet gap.

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The central source hypothesis links gap-dependent ISC to triplet-mediated oxygen sensitization, supported by the probe comparison.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: AIE is observed, but the selected source does not separately demonstrate target-specific motion restriction.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Aggregation and encapsulation are reported, but a distinct confinement mechanism is not isolated.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Polymer nanoparticle formulation and peptide conjugation are not evidence of a host-cavity binding mechanism.
